evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI described GPT-4o as GPT-4-level and matching GPT-4 Turbo on English text and code, while reporting gains in other languages, vision, and audio. This supports caution about a broad leap but does not establish the absence of one across the field.

evidence_items.locator: A note from Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai
evidence_items.explanation: Google announced a million-token context preview and new long-context capabilities. This is material counterevidence to an unrestricted claim of no breakthroughs, but it does not establish equivalence to the broad GPT-4 leap.

Anthropic reported stronger benchmark performance and improved factual accuracy. These advances must be considered, but a company's announcement does not establish that their magnitude matched GPT-4's earlier leap.

evidence_items.explanation: The accompanying paragraph reports $25.2 billion of generative-AI private investment in 2023. That annual financing measure neither establishes nor disproves cumulative spending specifically aimed at surpassing GPT-4.
